name: segue-hrms
description: Segue HRMS — enterprise human capital management (NestJS API + Next.js web)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && node -e "const f=require('fs');for(const [s,d] of [['backend/.env.example','backend/.env'],['frontend/.env.example','frontend/.env.local']])if(!f.existsSync(d))f.copyFileSync(s,d)" && npm run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start:prod" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
